parameters.name: ContentType
parameters.description:
The type of message that the server sends to the specified device when the JT/T 808 protocol is used. Valid values:

- **0**: detailed positioning data of the GNSS module.
- **11**: IC card information of the road transport certificate.
- **65**: serial port 1 pass-through.
- **66**: serial port 2 pass-through.
- **240** to **255**: user-defined pass-through.

For more information about the JT/T 808 protocol supported by IoT Platform, see [Overview of JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway](~~474256~~).

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description: The device name of the device that receives the message.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or **ID** value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the message is sent.

parameters.name: RequestBase64Byte
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded string of the message content to be sent, for example, `dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl`.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout period for waiting for the device response. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 1000 to 8000.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description:
The custom RRPC-related topic. The device must be developed accordingly. For more information, see [Custom topic](~~90570~~) in device development.
If you do not specify this parameter, the default system RRPC topic is used.
